facts.fact: 全章开篇断言老年名声极差；社会把老年写成战区，教人对抗、开战或者干脆假装它没发生
facts.anchor: which depicts old age as a war zone

facts.fact: 作者承认二十年来有某种进步：退休不再意味着座钟与扶手椅，如今常被说成第二阵风，或换一种生活方式
facts.anchor: There has been progression of sorts over the last twenty years. Gone are the days when retirement signalled a carriage clock gift for dutiful service and a begonia-edged path straight to our armchair and slippers. Now, it often means a second wind

facts.fact: Hedi 是社区里最年长的成员，她乐于担这个位置
facts.anchor: says Hedi, the oldest member of the community, a position she is happy to hold

facts.fact: 全社区共二十六位女性，在个体与集体两个层面上学习变老
facts.anchor: As a group of twenty-six women, we are learning to age, individually and collectively

facts.fact: 作者区分两种同理心：认知同理心可能随年龄下降，情感同理心更可能保持甚至上升
facts.anchor: While our cognitive empathy (the ability to see something from another’s perspective) may dip as we get older, our emotional empathy is more likely to remain or even rise

facts.fact: 社区按领域设任务组，涵盖建筑本体、现居与未来成员、家务、花园、财务与传播
facts.anchor: We established task groups that cover every area of New Ground including the building itself, resident and future membership, housekeeping, the garden, finance and communications

facts.fact: 做过舞台布景设计的 Hilary 因擅长解决问题而进了建筑组
facts.anchor: Hilary, who was a theatre set designer and is used to problem-solving, is part of the buildings team

facts.fact: Diana 说自己没能按希望的方式出力，但社区最初那个网站是她建的
facts.anchor: I did build our original website
